Starts a period on `start` (logged already). It replaces what it overlaps: an earlier
period ends the day before, periods starting inside it are removed. 422
`invalid_rest_period` also when `start` is logged by now with another status.

put.description:
"Keep the pause": restores a period cut by 🧘 Practiced exactly as it was (same
overlap rule as a new one). `period: null` once it is over (nothing left to keep), or
when no 🧘 Practiced day inside it shows it was cut (never a backfill), or when a newer
pause started after the cut (never undone).

post.description:
Renders one card of the caller's own data (two tones only: no rest, 🌸 or unlogged
days; no name). 404 `not_found` (an event or count that isn't the caller's or can't be
shared); 422 `invalid_period` (future), `nothing_to_share` (no practice); 429
`rate_limited` (50 cards per 24 h); 503 `unavailable` when cards are off.

The bot posts the card as a photo in the caller's own chat, once per card. 409
`already_sent`, `bot_unreachable` (blocked or never started); 404 for someone else's,
unknown or expired cards.

post.description:
PR-08 Phase 3: a linked teacher marks one of the card's `next_asanas`; the student gets
one silent message and can undo it. Not optimistic: the answer is the refreshed card, the
same whatever the student's history or the message's delivery. 404 `not_linked`;
409 `progression_changed` (out of date, or a retry: refetch the card); 422
`invalid_progression` (`to` isn't within the next stops of `from`).
